charter: Script-generation boundary: local agents generate scripts and interpret aggregate outputs only.
RAP-only execution: real participant-level records stay inside the approved RAP project.
Do not expose real row-level tables, identifiers, exact dates, per-row predictions, SHAP matrices, screenshots, tracebacks, or logs with row-level values to the agent.
Only aggregate outputs and non-identifying rendered figures may be shared back with the agent.
Schema-only prompts are allowed: infer column roles from the user's description, use synthetic toy data for smoke tests, and write final scripts for RAP execution.
Large extracts go async via rap_submit_extract().
Every function name referenced must exist in UKBAnalytica NAMESPACE.
Neutral plotting names; no journal-brand styling references.

skills.name: ukbsci-rap-extract
skills.summary: Discover, plan, and execute UK Biobank field extractions on RAP via dx extract_dataset (sync) or table-exporter (async).

skills.name: ukbsci-cohort
skills.summary: Define UKB disease phenotypes from multiple sources and build Cox-ready survival datasets with build_survival_dataset().

skills.name: ukbsci-workflow
skills.summary: End-to-end UKB study orchestrator: produces a phased plan, calls the right sub-skills in order, and writes a wrap-up note.

skills.name: ukbsci-regression
skills.summary: Batch linear / logistic / Cox regression with PH diagnostics, lag sensitivity, Fine-Gray competing risks, and trend tests.

skills.name: ukbsci-survival
skills.summary: Kaplan-Meier curves with risk tables and log-rank p-values via plot_km_curve.

skills.name: ukbsci-baseline
skills.summary: Stratified Table 1 (baseline characteristics) wrapping tableone over UKBAnalytica cohorts.

skills.name: ukbsci-propensity
skills.summary: Propensity scores, PSM, IPTW (ATE/ATT/ATC), balance diagnostics, weighted regression with robust SEs.

skills.name: ukbsci-mediation
skills.summary: Causal mediation analysis (regmedint 4-way decomposition); single + multi-mediator with sensitivity.

skills.name: ukbsci-subgroup-sensitivity
skills.summary: Subgroup × interaction tests; sensitivity filters (drop early events, complete-case).

skills.name: ukbsci-imputation
skills.summary: Multiple imputation (mice) and Rubin's-rules pooling (mitools) with FMI diagnostics; supports custom-estimate pooling.

skills.name: ukbsci-proteomics
skills.summary: UKB Olink / UKB-PPP downstream: ID mapping, GO / KEGG ORA, STRING PPI, community detection, robustness.

skills.name: ukbsci-ml
skills.summary: End-to-end ML workflows (classification + survival): split, feature select, tune, fit, evaluate, compare, SHAP.

skills.name: ukbsci-preprocess
skills.summary: Variable cleaning, negative-code sanitation, composite-variable builders (BP / air pollution / diet score), variable-set catalog.

skills.name: ukbsci-plot
skills.summary: Manuscript figure production: forest, volcano, calibration; shared neutral theme/palettes; multi-format save helper.
